search_window.basis: Starts at latest verified prior hourly Care Line Watch completion. Searches identify fresh published or effective changes, but publication-date-only reports cannot be assigned a specific hour.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary Care Line recall; primary national production collector remains authoritative.

cms_public_notices.summary: Read the official CMS Public Notices page directly before the targeted searches. The three newest termination notices are dated October 23; no October 29 notice appears.

coverage_notes.limitations: Twelve narrowly targeted news searches were screened for U.S. and territory relevance, concrete essential-service access consequences, recency and duplication. Search results included older events, Canada and other countries, proposed closures and new service launches. The production collector was not altered or read for full item-level deduplication; the private watch ledger was used to exclude known recalls.
coverage_notes.controls: Exactly one heartbeat written to ops/watch-ledger. No approval, public publication, collector modifications, schedule edits or task disabling.
